paper.title: Algorithm 777: HOMPACK90: a suite of Fortran 90 codes for globally convergent homotopy algorithms

field: numerics (homotopy continuation for fixed points of nonlinear systems)
stack: Fortran 90 (TOMS 777.gz: a shar with Doc/, Src/{hompack90.f,lapack.f,blas1-3.f}, Drivers/{driver1-3.f,template.f,DATA2,RES1-3}, Info/depend; the shipped expected output RES3 is produced by driver3.f)

claim.text: The shipped driver3 output RES3, block 'TESTING FIXPQS WITH STORAGE MODE = 1', prints the first solution component Y(1) at lambda = 1 as 4.00864019E-01. Rebuilt from the archive and run, the same block gives Y(1) within tol_abs 1e-8. Registered in the queue entry before any run; the TOMS article was not read (paywalled), so the claim rests on the shipped RES3.

values.name: FIXPQS storage mode 1, solution component Y(1) at lambda=1

attempt: Reproduced at the registered claim. Both passes (clean rebuilds of the unpacked shar, same build commands, each run of driver3) print Y(1) = 0.400864019 for FIXPQS storage mode 1 at lambda = 1, equal to the shipped RES3 value 4.00864019E-01 to the nine printed figures and within tol_abs 1e-8. The whole FIXPQS, FIXPNS and FIXPDS output (both storage modes) matches RES3 except the EXECUTION TIME lines, which are machine-dependent and not used. The authors' archive was unpacked as shipped and no source file was edited (build-only record, exit recorded in result.json patch). The Info/README gives the compile order (hompack90.f, lapack.f, blas1.f, blas2.f, blas3.f, driver3.f) and no compiler command; gfortran with default flags is ours, so the basis is patched (build-only), not original. The compiler emits warnings in hompack90.f (a shape mismatch in a DNRM2 call and a type warning) that did not change the output.

original_attempt.reason: The README's compile-and-link order was followed with gfortran, which is not named there, so the first build (pass1-build.log, exit 0) is partial in the strict sense. No step of the authors' procedure failed; the README gives no build tool, so the compiler is the one thing not documented.

build_commands: (cd Src && gfortran -c lapack.f blas1.f blas2.f blas3.f)
